readyOverlays.warningSv: Ungefärligt inpassad karta från 1894. Kartan är småskalig; avvikelser på hundratals meter eller mer förekommer. Den visar inte exakta byggnadsfotavtryck.

georeferencing.type: Printed-graticule polynomial rectification plus least-squares two-parameter translation from five church reference points
georeferencing.primeMeridianInterpretation: Longitude labels decrease eastward (5.5,5,4.5,4 degrees) and are interpreted as west of Helsinki. This is an inference consistent with Finnish map-series catalogues, not an explicit note on this scan. Empirical translation then aligns five mapped church symbols with modern register reference points.
georeferencing.churchReferenceNotes: Representative registry points for ecclesiastical areas, not independent surveyed building-corner control. Pixel symbols are hand-read. Residuals assess local alignment only and cannot certify the whole map.
georeferencing.maskDescription: WGS84 output rectangle intersected with scanned map inner frame x82..3290,y94..2210. Outer border/no data transparent; mapped sea retained.
georeferencing.outputResampling: Bilinear in original RGBA scan; WebMercator north-up result.
